content_tree.primary_claim: Real-time light fields, computed on the GPU
content_tree.supporting_text: A single WebGPU device drives signed-distance fields, volumetric scattering and physically-based tone mapping without a frame of pre-baked geometry.

content_tree.primary_claim: One device, no render thread gymnastics

items.title: Compute-first geometry
items.body: Signed-distance fields are evaluated in a compute pass, so the raster stage only shades what the rays actually hit.

items.title: Frame-rate independent motion
items.body: Spring choreography integrates delta time, so camera easing is identical at 60Hz and 144Hz.

items.title: DPR clamped surfaces
items.body: The device-pixel ratio is clamped and the render loop pauses off-screen, keeping the tab responsive on integrated GPUs.

content_tree.supporting_text: Every surface below is declared as a Context JSON block and compiled into a semantic figure with an accessible canvas.
The demo is a single HTML file with no build step and no framework.
